description: One-off check of whether a website is up right now, from OhSnap's probe network. Works without an account. Use when the user asks "is my site down?", "is X up?", or wants a status code, response time, or the reason a site fails (DNS failure, SSL error, timeout, HTTP error, Cloudflare edge error). Results are cached for 60 seconds per site, and each user can run 10 checks per minute.

url.description: Website URL or bare domain, e.g. "example.com" or "https://example.com/shop".

name: check_website
title: Check if a website is up
